item.title: MAC FM · Saturday 3 October 2026
item.description:
MAC Fellas, morning. Flydubai Cargo just launched its first scheduled B737-800 freighter network. Three dedicated narrowbodies? That’s a big shift for regional capacity. Exactly. It might pull e-commerce flows away from belly space. Speaking of e-commerce, lithium battery shipments are under stricter safety review. Tighter compliance could slow down handling for high-volume electronics. Definitely something to watch. Stay sharp, everyone.
